name: RigAnything Motion
description: Auto-rig any 3D model (human, quad, multi) and apply text-to-motion animations using HY-Motion-1.0 Lite.
author: iammojogo

params_schema.label: Simplify Mesh
params_schema.tooltip: Simplify the mesh before rigging for better performance.

params_schema.label: Target Face Count
params_schema.tooltip: Target number of faces after simplification (only used when Simplify Mesh is Yes).

params_schema.label: Apply Motion
params_schema.tooltip: Generate and apply text-to-motion animation to the rigged model.

params_schema.label: Motion Guidance Scale
params_schema.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance strength for motion generation. Higher = more literal.

params_schema.label: Motion Quality
params_schema.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps for motion generation.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to -1 for a random seed.
